name: Pellinore

attributes.attribute: brother of the Fisher King Pelles
a knight of the Round Table

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Pellinore is a hero of the Arthurian tales. He was the brother of Pelles, the Fisher King. Pellinore was a great knight of the Round Table. Some texts make him the father of the pure Percival.

okr.objective: Summarize Pellinore as an Arthurian knight.
key_results: State that Pellinore was brother of the Fisher King Pelles
Note his place at the Round Table
Report that some texts make him the father of Percival
